facts.fact: Astrid 拼出 Atalanthya 隐瞒了一个妹妹且她是 Archivist
facts.anchor: And it turns out the woman is an Archivist.

facts.fact: Emerson 回忆 Iris 的血誓：毁掉 Atalanthya 并斩其血脉
facts.anchor: I will destroy Atalanthya Moon, and I will end her bloodline before all this is over.

facts.fact: 她质疑母亲并非圣徒、或 Atalanthya 真的更强
facts.anchor: What if my mother wasn’t the saint we’ve been building her up to be?

facts.fact: Jaruwah 是雇佣枪手仍被 Magnus 关在地牢
facts.anchor: Jaruwah Godwin is a hired gun.

facts.fact: 空地六女列阵三座火堆
facts.anchor: Behind the pyres, a group of six women had assembled into a semicircle.

facts.fact: 侍女面无表情命令脱衣
facts.anchor: “Remove your clothing,” one of the women commanded, her expression entirely devoid of emotion.
She debated her options for a moment, and then threw caution to the wind.

facts.fact: 姐姐的痛苦教义：强者克服痛苦最优秀者学会爱上它
facts.anchor: The strong overcome their suffering, but the best of us come to love it.

facts.fact: 她不示弱踏入火焰惊觉冰冷
facts.anchor: Not to be cowed, Emerson raised her chin and stepped into the flames.

facts.fact: 妹妹领她们入林时裙子在死寂的空气里翻卷
facts.anchor: The woman’s dress billowed out behind her despite the fact that the air in the woods was so still it might have been dead.
